'''2014 Worlds Day 2 unnamed DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Unknown Player]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name boxes blank. Dest [[Unknown Player]]. Deck name BHU Syndicate.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself|VB9-D-separatistuprising-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
